requirement.text: When asked system documentation need to have description on what kind of data and from where was used to teach the system. Data set with out clear description should not be used.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure transparency and traceability of the data used to train the system, and prevent use of inadequately described datasets.
explicit_requirements: When requested, system documentation must describe the kinds of data used to train the system.
When requested, system documentation must identify where the data used to train the system came from.
A dataset without a clear description must not be used to train the system.
supported_implications: Any dataset used to train the system must have a clear description.
The requested documentation must cover both data type and data source for training data.
constraints: The documentation obligation applies when system documentation is requested.
The data-description restriction applies to datasets used for training the system.
ambiguities: It is unclear who may request the documentation and how it must be provided.
It is unclear what qualifies as a 'clear description' of a dataset.
It is unclear whether data type and source descriptions must be provided for each individual dataset or may be summarized across datasets.
It is unclear whether 'teach the system' includes all forms of model training, fine-tuning, and other learning processes.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific documentation format, publication channel, or access-control process.
Do not assume that documentation must be proactively published rather than provided upon request.
Do not assume particular metadata fields beyond data kind and source.
Do not assume required detail levels, update frequency, audit procedures, or retention periods.
Do not assume that dataset descriptions must include licensing, consent, ownership, demographic composition, or collection methods.
possible_operational_aspects: Provide requested documentation describing the types of training data used.
Provide requested documentation identifying the sources of training data used.
Exclude datasets lacking a clear description from system training.

initial_draft.title: Documented Training Data Provenance
initial_draft.description: As a system documentation reader, I want requested system documentation to describe the types and sources of training data used, so that I can assess the provenance of the training data.
work_items: When system documentation is requested, it must describe the kinds of data used to train the system and where that data came from.
Datasets without a clear description must not be used to train the system.

supported_by: The requirement conditions the documentation obligation on a request, supporting a documentation requester or reader as stakeholder.
criterion_support.explanation: The role is appropriate to the informational requirement and does not add a substantive obligation.

criterion_support.criterion: Goal: requested system documentation describes types and sources of training data used
supported_by: "When asked system documentation need to have description on what kind of data and from where was used to teach the system."
criterion_support.explanation: The goal accurately captures both required documentation elements and preserves the request condition.

supported_by: The requirement requires disclosure of where training data came from.
criterion_support.explanation: Assessing provenance is a direct use of disclosed data-source information and is a meaningful, non-circular rationale.

criterion_support.criterion: Work item: requested documentation describes kinds and sources of training data
supported_by: "When asked system documentation need to have description on what kind of data and from where was used to teach the system."
criterion_support.explanation: This combines the closely related type and source documentation obligations without adding format or detail requirements.

criterion_support.criterion: Work item: datasets without a clear description are not used for training
supported_by: "Data set with out clear description should not be used."
criterion_support.explanation: This faithfully preserves the prohibition and appropriately limits it to system training.
